components.name: Button
components.summary: A button for one action, in three weights that follow the Psi and Omega shape rule.

components.name: Status
components.summary: One result, shown as an arch-topped pip with a word beside it: checked, trap or open.

components.name: Tile
components.summary: A square-cornered block that holds one idea, drawn in outline for target-neutral things and solid for realized ones.

components.name: CodeBlock
components.summary: Code or a command on surface, under an ink rule across the top, set in code.

components.name: PlaceGrid
components.summary: One fact across the nine places, as a 3×3 grid of results in place order, with a count beneath it.
